default.title: HUNGRY
default.speaker: You
default.text: It's 9 pm. Swiggy biryani is ₹500. There's bread and a ₹20 chips packet at home. Friends said turf cricket tomorrow — ₹150 each.

earner.title: HUNGRY
earner.speaker: You
earner.text: Shift just ended. Swiggy biryani is ₹500, or the ₹20 chips from the shop. Friends said turf cricket tomorrow — ₹150 each.

choices.lesson: Felt great tonight. Tomorrow's turf match just got expensive.
choices.hint: What did you want more — biryani tonight or turf tomorrow?

choices.lesson: A need met for ₹20. The ₹480 you kept is tomorrow's fun.
Saved money, lost a little mood. A ₹20 need was worth meeting.

default.title: MONTH START
default.speaker: Aunty
default.text: Money just came in. Do you put some aside now, or 'whatever is left' at month end?

scholarship.title: ALLOWANCE IN
scholarship.speaker: Aunty
scholarship.text: The ePASS lump sum just landed in your account. All of it. Put some aside now, or 'whatever is left' later?

earner.title: PAYDAY
earner.speaker: Aunty
earner.text: Sunday cash in hand. Part goes home. Of the rest: set some aside now, or 'whatever is left' later?

choices.lesson: Pay yourself first. 'Whatever is left' is usually nothing.
Month end comes. The leftover is ₹0. It always is.
choices.hint: When is money easiest to save — day 1 or day 30?

default.title: SCAM CALL
default.speaker: Caller
default.text: I'm from the scholarship office. Pay ₹500 now or your money is cancelled!

pocket_money.title: SCAM TEXT
pocket_money.speaker: Unknown number
pocket_money.text: Mom's phone buzzes: 'OTP 448213 sent by mistake. Please share it back urgently.'

scholarship.title: SCAM CALL
scholarship.speaker: 'ePASS officer'
scholarship.text: Your allowance is approved! Pay a ₹500 processing fee now or it lapses today.

earner.title: FAKE PAYMENT
earner.speaker: Customer
earner.text: He shows a 'Payment successful ₹500' screenshot and grabs the bag. Your phone hasn't pinged.

choices.lesson: Real offices never ask you to pay to receive money. That ₹500 is gone.
choices.hint: Who asks for money to GIVE you money?

choices.lesson: Friends guess. The official portal knows.
Safe. Even safer: check the portal so you know for sure.
You verified at the source. That's the whole trick against scams.

default.title: UNCLE'S OFFER
default.speaker: Uncle
default.text: Beta, I can give you ₹1,000 today, or ₹1,000 next Sankranti. Your choice.

choices.lesson: Money today can be saved, used, or grown. Money later is just a promise.
Same ₹1,000, but a year of prices rising and a year of no growth.
